messages:
Evan P.: Dropping this thread for a focused design review on the model catalog compare table I just uploaded. Main issues: column density on small screens, how performance badges communicate latency vs throughput, and the pining scope (user vs org). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123 — please skim and flag blockers.

Rina (Design): Scanned it. Table gets cramped under 1200px; we should collapse less-critical columns into a 'metrics' flyout on mobile. Also concerned about relying on color for perf badges. Suggest: badge with icon + numeric label (e.g., ⚡ P95 120ms) and optional microtrend arrow. Keep badge background subtle.

Jules M.: Backend note: our metrics store has both p50/p95 and throughput. We should standardize which metric shows by default per model class (e.g., LLMs show P95 latency; rerankers show QPS). That metadata can live in model tags. Also about pins: current API stores pinned by user_id; org-wide pins are a separate flag. We need a clear UX toggle: 'Pin for me' vs 'Pin for workspace'.

Olivia S.: Copy nits: labels like 'perf' feel too terse. Use 'Latency (P95)' or 'Throughput (QPS)' depending on metric. For the pin modal, change heading from 'Pin model' to 'Set default compare model' to reduce confusion. Also accessibility: the badge icon needs an aria-label with the numeric value, eg aria-label="P95 latency 120 milliseconds".

UX-Bot: Accessibility scan: low contrast detected on pale green badge fill at 12% opacity. Recommend 3:1 contrast for small UI tokens or add a dark text label. Keyboard scan: table rows are focusable but action menu buttons are not reachable by arrow keys; ensure roving tabindex pattern for table actions.

Rina (Design): Proposed layout change: when screen width < 1100px hide 'guidance' and 'tags' columns, compress model name and version into single column with chevron to expand. For compare mode, pinned model should be visually separated at top with subtle divider. If pinned model is filtered out, show a persistent banner 'Pinned model hidden by active filters' with action 'Show pinned'.

Jules M.: Implementation detail: if we show pinned model while filtered out, it must still adhere to filter-related metrics (e.g. quantized metric vs non-quantized). I propose we show the pinned model but dim unrelated metrics and include a badge 'filter mismatch'. Also must ensure audit log records when workspace pins change.

Evan P.: Decision point: do we support two pin scopes now (personal + workspace) or ship personal-only and add workspace later? Cost/complexity?

Olivia S.: UX preference: ship both but hide workspace pin behind a dropdown 'Pin scope' with 'Only me' default and 'Workspace' opt-in. Requires backend support but reduces churn later. Suggest adding confirmation modal for workspace pins to avoid accidental global overrides.

Jules M.: Technical: adding workspace pins requires auth checks and granularity (team vs org). We can MVP with org-level only. I'll draft schema: ```json
{ "action": "set_pin", "scope": "org", "model_version": "mv-0a1b2c", "pinned_by": "user-123" }
``` We'll emit audit event `pin.changed` with prev/next. Cache invalidation via `pin.invalidate.<org>` topic.

Rina (Design): Accessibility follow-up: add focus trap in pin modal and ensure the confirmation button has clear language: 'Set default for workspace'. Also microcopy for 'Show pinned' banner: 'A pinned model is hidden by these filters. Show anyway.'

Evan P.: OK next steps: Rina — update Figma with collapsed mobile layout + banner copy by Tue. Jules — spec API change and minimal migration plan for workspace pins by Wed. Olivia — final copy pass and aria-label list by Wed. Rina/Olivia — pair on confirm modal a11y Thu AM. I'll book 30m review Thu 3:30pm. Thanks all. :calendar:
